name: Pergamon and its Multi-Layered Cultural Landscape
description: Pergamon's ancient acropolis sits on a steep 335-metre mesa above the Bakırçay Plain, near the modern town of Bergama in western Türkiye. Once the capital of the Attalid kings, it still has its hillside theatre, temples and library terraces, with Roman healing sanctuaries and burial mounds scattered below. The rock-cut Kybele Sanctuary sits on a neighbouring hill, linked by sightline to the summit.
